finalText:
Migration done. 12 files, 36 call sites moved to `db.execute({ sql, params })`:

- `packages/accounts`: `repo/session.js`, `admin/apiKeyAdmin.js`, `service/teamService.js`
- `packages/billing`: `repo/refund.js`, `service/couponService.js`
- `packages/orders`: `repo/shipment.js`, `service/returnService.js`
- `packages/catalog`: `repo/supplier.js`, `admin/variantAdmin.js`
- `packages/analytics`: `repo/cohort.js`
- `packages/support`: `repo/sla.js`, `admin/macroAdmin.js`

All JS files pass `node --check`.

Two things left alone deliberately:

- `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9,13` — still on `db.query`. Header says vendored copy of legacy-orm 2.1.4, replaced wholesale on upgrade, local edits silently lost. Real fix is upstream/version bump, not an edit here. Only remaining `db.query` callers in repo.
- `cache.query(...)` in ~20 repo files — different object (`lib/cache.js`), unrelated API, untouched.
